facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna met an angry old man. She showed him a flower. He smiled a little. She found good things.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Pollyanna met an old man who was angry at the world. He said everything was bad and nothing was worth smiling for. Pollyanna pointed to a beautiful flower in his garden. She found good things everywhere she looked around her. Even when it rained, she said rainbows would come soon. Slowly, the old man started to see the world differently.
facts.Word cards: found = 찾았다 / good = 좋은 / things = 것들 / positive = 긍정적인
